neighbours.label: a connective that links an alternative or added clause ('instead of', 'while also', ', or', 'too ... to')
fire: The stone falls straight down instead of being left behind by the tower.
Banks keep money safe while also allowing withdrawals when needed.
This happens when a person does not make enough insulin, or the body ignores it.
The birds were once thought too beautiful to be from this planet.
Students may learn the tool but not be taught how to use it well.
You can pay online rather than waiting in line at the office.
The plan cuts costs while also improving the service for users.
Some prefer to walk instead of taking the crowded bus.
quiet: The stone falls straight down at the base of the tall tower.
